Dear Outsight Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the UI Designer position at Outsight, as advertised. My background as a Front-End Developer and Web & SEO Specialist, combined with a robust technical skillset in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, aligns well with your emphasis on interfaces that not only look excellent but also behave thoughtfully and are technically sound.

My experience includes developing and optimizing front-end features for web applications and designing complete client websites, consistently focusing on user experience and technical implementation. I am particularly drawn to Outsight’s collaborative approach and commitment to building products that truly make sense for users and business.

I look forward to discussing how my blend of technical precision and user-focused web development can contribute to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Outsight Team,

Your description of the UI Designer role at Outsight immediately resonated with my professional approach and experience. I am particularly drawn to your philosophy of understanding what truly deserves to be built and creating digital products that are meaningful for users, business, and developers alike. My background combines technical development with a deep understanding of web mechanics and user intent, skills I believe are essential for translating product thinking into exceptional, functional interfaces.

As a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I gained valuable experience developing and optimizing features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This role cultivated a keen eye for how interfaces should behave, react, and change, rather than merely being a collection of static screens. More recently, as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I designed and built websites for clients from structure to content, demonstrating my ability to consider the entire user journey and implement thoughtful layouts, including managing consistent designs for hundreds of unique profile pages. My work on mirook.com further showcased my technical rigour in web optimization and understanding implementation details like JSON-LD schema and knowledge-graph markup.

While my primary tools have included WordPress and Elementor for visual composition, my core strength lies in the underlying technical craft, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, alongside a logical approach to component-based design. I understand the importance of designing with responsiveness and developer collaboration in mind, informed by my Python automation experience and constant communication with technical teams. My SEO expertise further grounds my design choices in user needs and measurable outcomes, ensuring that aesthetics complement usability and performance.

I appreciate Outsight’s collaborative environment, where challenge and collective problem-solving are valued. I am eager to contribute my blend of technical expertise, user-centric perspective, and commitment to detail to your team, ensuring interfaces are not only visually engaging but also robust and intuitive.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Outsight.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• One year as Front-End Developer (2018-2019), developing and optimizing features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript.
• Experience designing and building client websites in WordPress, from site structure to content, including creating consistent layouts for over 600 member profile pages.
• Strong technical foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, complemented by Python scripting and automation skills for efficient web development.
• Proficient in SEO principles and keyword research, contributing a user-centric perspective to web architecture and interface content decisions.
• Demonstrated collaborative ability by supporting teams in building digital workplace sites and managing client website projects.
